# Piston Origins

> Piston Origins is a car-history YouTube channel telling the origin stories of legendary cars: JDM icons like the Toyota Supra, Nissan Skyline GT-R, Mazda RX-7, Honda NSX and AE86, the engines behind them (2JZ, RB26, rotary, 4A-GE) and the rivalries, bans and comebacks that made them. A new full car story every week, plus 60-second car secrets in Shorts, with every source listed.

Piston Origins is on YouTube at https://www.youtube.com/@PistonOrigins and Instagram at https://www.instagram.com/pistonorigins/. The host (Skye) and narration voice are AI-generated; the research, facts and sources are real and listed in every video description and on each episode page below.

## Episodes (full car stories)

- [Toyota's 1995 WRC Turbo Restrictor Cheat: The Celica ST205 Ban](https://pistonorigins.com/episodes/toyota-celica-gt-four-1995-wrc-turbo-restrictor/): How Toyota Team Europe hid a turbo restrictor bypass in the Celica GT-Four ST205, was caught at Rally Catalunya 1995 and banned from the WRC for 12 months.
- [Ferrari vs Lamborghini: How a Broken Clutch Started a Rivalry](https://pistonorigins.com/episodes/ferrari-vs-lamborghini-origin-story/): How tractor maker Ferruccio Lamborghini took on Enzo Ferrari: the clutch row, the engineless 350 GTV, the Miura, the Countach and losing his company.
- [Nissan GT-R vs Porsche 911 Turbo: 2008 Nürburgring Dispute](https://pistonorigins.com/episodes/nissan-gt-r-vs-porsche-911-turbo-nurburgring/): In 2008 Porsche bought a Nissan GT-R R35, lapped the Nürburgring in 7:54 against Nissan's claimed 7:29 and suggested race tyres. Here is how Nissan answered.
- [Lexus LFA History: The V10 Supercar Toyota Lost Money On](https://pistonorigins.com/episodes/lexus-lfa-story/): Lexus LFA history: the Yamaha-built 4.8-litre V10, the switch from aluminium to carbon fibre, the Nürburgring, and why Toyota lost money on all 500 cars.
- [Honda NSX (NA1) History: Senna, VTEC and an Aluminium Supercar](https://pistonorigins.com/episodes/honda-nsx-story/): Honda NSX (NA1) history: the HP-X concept, the aluminium body, Ayrton Senna's "fragile" verdict at Suzuka, the C30A VTEC V6 and what an NSX is worth today.
- [Toyota AE86 History: Why the Hachi-Roku Became a Drift Legend](https://pistonorigins.com/episodes/toyota-ae86-story/): Toyota AE86 history: the rear-drive Corolla Levin and Sprinter Trueno, the 4A-GE twin-cam, Keiichi Tsuchiya, Initial D and the Takumi tax on prices today.
- [Mazda Rotary Engine History: RX-7, 787B and the Le Mans Win](https://pistonorigins.com/episodes/mazda-rotary-engine-rx-7-787b-story/): Mazda rotary engine history, from the 1961 NSU Wankel licence and the devil's nail marks to the RX-7, the 787B's 1991 Le Mans win and the 2023 comeback.
- [Why the Nissan Skyline GT-R R34 Was Banned in the US](https://pistonorigins.com/episodes/nissan-skyline-gt-r-r34-banned-in-america/): Why the Nissan Skyline GT-R R34 was banned in the US: the RB26DETT, FMVSS rules, the Motorex loophole, the 25-year rule and the $1.357m Paul Walker car.
- [Toyota Supra Mk4 (A80) History: The 2JZ and How It Was Built](https://pistonorigins.com/episodes/toyota-supra-mk4-story/): Toyota Supra Mk4 (A80) history: from the 2000GT and Celica Supra to Isao Tsuzuki's "less is more" design, the 2JZ-GTE sequential twin-turbo and its legacy.

## Engine guides

- [13B-REW Rotary Engine: Specs, Apex Seals and Problems](https://pistonorigins.com/engines/13b-rew-rotary/): 13B-REW and Mazda 13B rotary explained: specs, sequential twin turbos, FD RX-7 history, apex seal failures, known problems and realistic tuning limits.
- [Lexus LFA Engine: The Yamaha-Built 1LR-GUE V10 Explained](https://pistonorigins.com/engines/1lr-gue/): The Lexus LFA's 1LR-GUE V10: 4.8 litres, 9,000 rpm and idle to redline in 0.6 seconds. Specs, Yamaha's role, design details and what LFAs sell for today.
- [2JZ-GTE Engine: Specs, History and Why It's So Strong](https://pistonorigins.com/engines/2jz-gte/): 2JZ-GTE specs, history and tuning facts: Toyota's 3.0-litre twin-turbo inline-six from the Mk4 Supra, why it's so strong and where it is weak.
- [Toyota 3S-GTE Engine: Generations, Specs and History](https://pistonorigins.com/engines/3s-gte/): Toyota 3S-GTE generations explained: the 2.0-litre turbo four from the Celica GT-Four, MR2 Turbo and Caldina, with specs, rally history and tuning limits.
- [4A-GE Engine: Specs, Generations and Tuning Potential](https://pistonorigins.com/engines/4a-ge/): Toyota 4A-GE specs and history: the 1.6-litre twin-cam from the AE86, its 16- and 20-valve generations, cars fitted, weaknesses and how much power it makes.
- [Honda C30A Engine: The NSX's VTEC V6, Specs and History](https://pistonorigins.com/engines/c30a/): Honda C30A specs and history: the 3.0-litre VTEC V6 with titanium connecting rods that powered the original NSX, how it was designed and where it is weak.
- [RB26DETT Engine: Specs, History and RB26 vs 2JZ](https://pistonorigins.com/engines/rb26dett/): RB26DETT specs, history and weaknesses: the Skyline GT-R's 2.6-litre twin-turbo six built for Group A racing, tuning limits and how it compares to the 2JZ.
- [Nissan VR38DETT: The Hand-Built GT-R Engine, Specs and History](https://pistonorigins.com/engines/vr38dett/): Nissan VR38DETT specs and history: the R35 GT-R's 3.8-litre twin-turbo V6, hand-built by takumi at Yokohama, its power from 480 to 600 PS and how it tunes.

## Glossary

- [Car Glossary: JDM, Engine and Motorsport Terms Explained](https://pistonorigins.com/glossary/): What JDM, homologation, VTEC, Group B, apex seals and the 25-year import rule mean: 31 car-culture terms explained in plain English, every source listed.

## FAQ

- **What is Piston Origins?** Piston Origins is a car-history channel on YouTube. Each full episode tells the origin story of one legendary car, such as the Toyota Supra Mk4, Nissan Skyline GT-R R34, Mazda RX-7, Honda NSX or Toyota AE86, and each 60-second Short reveals one little-known fact about a car or engine.
- **Who presents Piston Origins? Is the host real?** The host, Skye, and the narration voice are AI-generated. The research, facts and sources are real, and every source is listed in the video description and on the episode page on this site.
- **How often does Piston Origins post new videos?** A new full car story every week, plus 60-second car secrets in YouTube Shorts.
- **Where do Piston Origins' facts come from?** Each episode is written from a reference sheet in which every fact has a source: manufacturer press material, magazines such as Car and Driver, Top Gear and Hagerty, auction results and reference works. Those sources are listed on each episode page. Anything that cannot be sourced is cut or softened.
- **Which cars has Piston Origins covered?** Toyota Supra Mk4, Nissan Skyline GT-R R34, Mazda RX-7 and 787B, Toyota AE86, Honda NSX, Lexus LFA, Nissan GT-R R35, Toyota Celica GT-Four ST205, and the Ferrari vs Lamborghini rivalry.
- **Can I suggest a car for Piston Origins to cover?** Yes. Leave a comment on any Piston Origins video on YouTube or send a message on Instagram (@pistonorigins). Topics are picked from the comments.
